snippet.title: FUR Squadron Phoenix | Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
All aircraft, attention! FUR Squadron Phoenix is taking off as soon as early 2026!

Get ready for an action-packed roguelite space adventure. Unlock new abilities, weapons, and skins for your starfighter and prepare to take the battle to the next level.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM and don't miss its upcoming release!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674650/FUR_Squadron_Phoenix
